heading: Thursday, November 27, 2025
topLine: DeepSeek releases open-weight DeepSeekMath-V2 with reported IMO 2025 gold-level scores. Also: DeepSeek releases DeepSeekMath-V2 open math reasoning model.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases open-weight DeepSeekMath-V2 with reported IMO 2025 gold-level scores
items.summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeekMath-V2, a 685B-parameter open-weight model (Apache 2.0) that checks its own natural-language proofs. Its paper reports gold-level scores on IMO 2025 and CMO 2024 and 118/120 on Putnam 2024, using scaled test-time compute. These scores are self-reported and were not officially graded.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeekMath-V2 open math reasoning model
items.summary: DeepSeekMath-V2 is an open-weight mathematical reasoning model built on DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base that uses a proof generator with a separate verifier. DeepSeek reports gold-level performance on IMO 2025 problems and 118/120 on Putnam 2024.
